caption:
Think God only takes you once you've earned it? He came to find you first. (Amos 4:4 devotional)

Worship curdles into self-righteousness the moment we forget He came to find us first. Grace is not the prize for worship — it's the ground of it.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Am I trying to earn a welcome God already came to give me?
